title: EnvironmentDefinition
description: Fixture for a disposable lab (ADR-0007, ADR-0009). Referenced from lab.started by definition id + hash. Everything here runs only inside the learner sandbox. Withheld from the learner and from the tutor context: params may describe the injected fault.
